Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class AcousticValveBoundary

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.AcousticValveBoundary
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class AcousticValveBoundary extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable prescribed actual valve travel and liquid capacity for a single-line acoustic boundary.

Travel is linearly interpolated in physical seconds after a command plus measured delay. The first and last positions are held outside the table. Capacity reuses the strict, monotone cubic tabulated valve characteristic; no measurements are cleaned or fitted. This value object has no clock, actuator integration or event scheduler. The liquid law excludes choking, flashing, cavitation and reverse receiver flow.

1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • AcousticValveBoundary

      public AcousticValveBoundary(double[] openingFraction, double[] capacity, AcousticValveBoundary.CapacityUnit unit, double[] timeSeconds, double[] actualOpening, double commandTime, double delay)
      Define absolute liquid capacity versus position and a prescribed actual travel record.
      Parameters:
      openingFraction - strictly increasing capacity positions spanning zero to one
      capacity - nonnegative, nondecreasing capacity at those positions, final value positive
      unit - KV or CV_US; US Cv is divided by 1.156, as in ThrottlingValve
      timeSeconds - strictly increasing travel times, first exactly zero, at least two points
      actualOpening - actual opening fractions, each within zero to one; reopening is permitted
      commandTime - nonnegative command time on the existing pipe clock, seconds
      delay - nonnegative measured command-to-travel delay, seconds
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any table, unit, time or capacity is invalid

  • Method Details

    • getOpening

      public double getOpening(double time)
      Evaluate prescribed actual position, independent of call order. Exact absolute knots use the same command-plus-delay-plus-travel sums as nextKnotAfter and return the tabulated position exactly. Interpolation uses those representable absolute times, without an epsilon.
      Parameters:
      time - physical pipe time in seconds, finite and nonnegative
      Returns:
      actual opening fraction, zero to one
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if time is invalid

    • getKv
